D.title: Optimize indication sequencing
D.copy: Leading with the orphan indication delays IRA and MFN eligibility and earns extra EU-GPL exclusivity protection.
D.synergy: Prioritizing orphan indications avoids IRA or MFN selection and earns EU orphan exclusivity.

G.title: Ensure pre-launch evidence packages are payer-optimized
G.copy: Comparative data vs. SoC strengthens JCA answers and the US-vs-reference price position.
G.synergy: One comparative evidence package serves JCA, EU-GPL rewards and MFN price defence.

A.title: Consider asset selection
A.copy: Small-molecule status starts the 7-year IRA clock; a biologic profile would extend the full-price runway.

B.title: Consider post-launch evidence generation
B.copy: Real-world outcomes support IRA and MFN negotiations and JCA re-assessment.

I.title: Consider region-specific launch strategies
I.copy: EU-GPL rewards filing in the EU within 90 days of first global filing, but MFN advises delaying ex-US launch until evidence is robust.
